pages.title: Bluebuck
pages.text: The bluebuck ($(o)Hippotragus leucophaeus$()) is an extinct antelope that lived in the southwestern Cape of South Africa until around 1800.$(br2)It was a smaller relative of the roan and sable antelope, named for the bluish-grey sheen of its coat.$(br2)Already confined to a small range after the end of the Ice Age, it was hunted to extinction by European settlers, the first large African mammal lost in historical times.
